subject: Invoice sender and collector authorization — portal vs secure signed PDF
messages:
From: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@solstice.co>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.ai>
Cc: Accounts Payable <ap@solstice.co>
Date: Mon, 7 Jun 2027 09:12:00 -0400
Subject: Billing handoff and invoice sender — portal timing?

Hi Hannah,

Quick question as we prepare for production billing: our AP team needs clarity on who will originate Solstice invoices once you flip us to the Dedicated plan. We have two constraints:

- During portal onboarding we require signed PDF invoices for the first 2 monthly cycles (legal mandate + internal audit).
- We also need the invoice to include our PO number (PO: 9876) and explicit remit instructions to avoid payment delays.

Two options sound feasible to us:
1) Redwood sends invoices via portal push (SFTP/API) and separately posts a signed PDF copy to our secure DocuSign link during the pilot window.
2) Redwood emails a signed PDF directly to ap@solstice.co while we finalize portal enrollment.

Can you confirm which path Redwood prefers, who inside Redwood will be the invoice originator (name/email), and whether you can include the PO on the invoice PDF? We need to confirm a handoff plan by EOD Wed so AP can approve payment SLA.

Thanks —
Liam
Liam O'Connor
Head of Finance, Solstice Media
liam.oconnor@solstice.co
+1 415 555 7290

Attachment: Solstice_PO_9876.pdf (PDF, 42KB)
From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.ai>
To: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@solstice.co>
Cc: Accounts Payable <ap@solstice.co>, Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.ai>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 7 Jun 2027 12:05:00 -04:00
Subject: Re: Billing handoff and invoice sender — portal timing?

Hi Liam — thanks for the clear ask and for sharing the PO. Short answer: we can support both paths but want to align on the secure channel and the invoice originator for downstream reconciliation. Proposal below.

Proposal (pilot window — first 2 invoices):
- Originator: Redwood Inference, Billing (invoice@redwood.ai).
- Delivery: Push to Solstice portal via SFTP/API at midnight UTC on billing day, AND upload a signed PDF to your DocuSign folder the same morning (we will not email PDFs to reduce risk).
- Content: Invoice will include PO 9876 in the header, remit instructions, VAT tag (if applicable), and a clear billing contact line (solstice-ap@solstice.co).

Rationale: pushing to the portal keeps your AP system canonical; adding the signed PDF to DocuSign satisfies your audit. We avoid sending PDFs by email unless you explicitly request it (email is slower for our compliance team). If AP requires direct email delivery, we can add ap@solstice.co as a fallback but will need a signed acceptance from your procurement team.

Action items for us to enable this:
- Connor: can you confirm SFTP key exchange window and whether we need a specific filename schema?
- Kimberly: please prepare a signed invoice template and confirm DocuSign upload flow (DocuSign ID below).

Liam, if that works we’ll aim to flip the pilot config and send the first signed PDF on 2027-06-30.

Best,
Hannah
Hannah Schmitt
Sr. Revenue Operations Manager, Redwood Inference
hannah.schmitt@redwood.ai
From: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.ai>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.ai>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>, Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@solstice.co>
Date: Tue, 8 Jun 2027 08:45:00 -04:00
Subject: Re: Billing handoff and invoice sender — portal timing?

Following up on Hannah's plan with some technical notes:

- File naming: we'll use solstice_PO9876_YYYYMMDD_invoice.pdf for the portal push and DocuSign upload. That matches our downstream reconciliation keys.
- SFTP exchange: we need a host key from Solstice and a target directory. Liam — can your AP team provide host key and preferred transfer window (we typically do 02:00–04:00 UTC)?
- Invoice metadata: we will include a machine-readable XML payload alongside the PDF for your AP system (optional). If you prefer only PDF, state so and we'll disable XML.

Security/compliance note: per our SOC 2 controls, DocuSign uploads must come from an internal billing role (kimberly.park@redwood.ai) and be recorded in our audit log. We will provide a signed PDF stub (invoice attached for example) and a delivery receipt to your AP mailbox.

Connor
Connor O'Brien
Billing Systems Engineer, Redwood Inference
connor.obrien@redwood.ai

Attachment: redwood-signed-invoice-20270607.pdf (PDF, 58KB)
From: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@solstice.co>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.ai>, Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.ai>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>
Cc: Accounts Payable <ap@solstice.co>
Date: Thu, 10 Jun 2027 15:22:00 -04:00
Subject: Re: Billing handoff and invoice sender — portal timing?

Thanks all — that plan works for Solstice. A few confirmations before we close the loop:

1) Please use the filename convention Connor listed.
2) We will provide SFTP host/key by EOD Friday (2027-06-11).
3) We accept the XML payload but will treat PDF as authoritative for payment evidence during the pilot.
4) For the fallback: if the portal push fails, Redwood may email the signed PDF to ap@solstice.co — please include a delivery receipt and note the failure reason.

One last ask — can Kimberly include the VAT/Tax line items on the PDF and add a short note about reverse charge applicability? That helps our AP team reconcile VAT for cross-border vendors. If you need Solstice's VAT registration number, I can share it (we use GB123456789 for the UK entity).

Appreciate the quick turnaround. Once SFTP details are in, we'll update our vendor record and confirm the SLA.

-Liam
